title: Fix hardcoded absolute paths and relative path resolution in storage and config
description: Data/vars.json has a hardcoded absolute D:\@Repos\MemorySmith\ path that breaks on other machines. SqliteMemorySmithDatabase.EnsureDatabaseDirectory resolves relative paths against the process working directory instead of AppContext.BaseDirectory. MemorySmithStorageSetup path resolution differs between IOptions binding and direct factory resolution. Fix: use relative/repo-root-resolved paths at runtime, resolve storage paths against AppContext.BaseDirectory consistently, and gitignore vars.json with a template. Source: codebase-audit-20260710-swarm-synthesis P2-033

comments.author: anonymous
comments.body: Approved for Wave 1, execution order 03 of 09. Prioritized next because machine-specific and working-directory-dependent paths cause portability and deployment failures.
